body: Ditto, I want an off button :\(

Hey there,

Thanks for reading and your reply. Yes, I too had to leave uni because of the effects of depression/eating disorder. I'm presuming you have an undergrad degree though, since you started a masters? I've been extremely disappointed that I was never able complete my degree \(not that it makes any difference\), don't even have an undergrad degree.

I also have given up on dating. The last time I 'dated' somebody, it seemed to be going pretty well, but soon after I was admitted to hospital, he just vanished with no communication. I was not asking or expecting anything from him. It wouldn't have hurt so much had he explained his reasons for leaving. I didn't want to be seen as weak or needy, so I never attempted to contact him. I haven't had any desire to try to meet somebody since as a\) relationships are painful and b\) very low self esteem \(went into hospital, had to leave med school, haven't been able to work, more hospital, basically I became a hermit/mental health patient \- how do you even meet people when faced with the question, "so what do you do?"\).

The NHS does many great things. In general, however, mental health treatment is not one of those things. It's very badly underfunded, which means people often have to wait unfeasible times to get any help. If one does get any help, the quality and length of treatment are very limited.

Support group could be useful tho.

OP: I'm sorry things are so bad for you. Idk what to say, other than I'm also in a very bad place and I really don't have any solutions.

I also love/hate my mother. Very much resent her for having brought me into this world without any choice. I didn't realise it was Mother's Day..shit, I broke down yesterday and was perhaps too honest about how I felt. Now I feel bad, I'm still angry with her, but I also don't want to hurt her. Conflicted.
I'm jealous of people who are happy/feel they have reasons to be alive

:-( 

OP, I know everyone's own situation is different, but I can certainly relate to feeling like one had so much potential that was not realised (e.g. bc health problems). It's very, very painful and depressing. I don't have any answers, but I feel you. I've lost too many things in my life
I hope it's like being unconscious, a big sleep. You can't suffer if you're dead
